official_split: reports/m3/plant_splits.json assignments.official; 24 train/12 val/12 test plants; 16 scans each
primary: plant-level macro leaf instance PQ; strict IoU > 0.5, identical to M6-A

sampling.sampling: uniform without replacement, no GT-guided sampling; epoch-specific resampling from fixed train pool
sampling.inference: fixed uniform full-cloud sample; deterministic seed 20261012+plant_id*100+DAS; nearest-neighbor restoration to every PLY vertex
sampling.normalization: full-cloud bounding-box midpoint and half maximum extent; retain center_m and scale_m; inverse xyz=normalized*scale+center
sampling.augmentation: train only: z-axis rotation; no future, labels or phenotype metadata as input

supervision.semantic: 0 taproot, 1 core, 2 leaf, unchanged three-way CE; never interpret source species stem/leaf codes as Sugar4D codes
supervision.instance: current-frame leaf nonnegative IDs remapped locally, randomly permuted per epoch; nonleaf sentinel -1
supervision.loss: official 10 CE + 10 L1 discriminative embedding (delta_v=.5, delta_d=1.5, reg=.001) + published-source double-hinge similarity (alpha=10,C_same=10,C_diff=80)
supervision.masking: taproot/core retain distinct semantic supervision; discriminative and pair similarity leaf-only; pair weights computed independently per frame
supervision.source_fidelity: retain official unusual positive-pair relu(80-D) exactly; no undocumented hinge-sign correction
forbidden: GT leaf count or GT-guided points

methods.S2: official PlantNet pretrained epoch199 finetune; all trainable, semantic head random

training.lr_schedule: cosine decay to 0.00002 over exactly 60 epochs
training.checkpoint_selection: highest Validation plant-macro full-resolution PQ with bandwidth .6; ties earliest epoch; never use Test
training.validation_loss: no label updates or batchnorm updates; current evaluation labels only in evaluator
training.budget_policy: all 384 train frames each epoch; no result-dependent extension; 23040 frame presentations, 5760 optimizer updates per run
training.adequacy: 60 vs official 200 epochs is bounded target-domain baseline; report convergence diagnostics and do not interpret undertraining as architecture failure

postprocessing.cluster: official sklearn MeanShift, bin_seeding=True,n_jobs=1 on five-dimensional embedding; clusters of predicted semantic leaf points only
postprocessing.selection: after checkpoint selection, select per run highest Validation plant-macro PQ; tie .6 then smaller bandwidth
postprocessing.filter: do not delete clusters by GT counts/sizes; no source-species mean-size filter on target leaves

evaluation.test_role: exploratory fixed-scheme replication; repeatedly used in M3-M6-A, not an untouched blind test
evaluation.small_leaf: GT fraction <= train-only q25 leaf-point fraction; no GT-guided inference
evaluation.core_adjacent: at least 10 percent of leaf points within 5mm of current-frame GT core; evaluation-only proximity proxy, not manually certified unseparated leaf
evaluation.error_definitions: M6-A overlap >10% of GT leaf for merge/split; report denominators explicitly
evaluation.confidence_interval: 10000 independent-plant bootstrap samples, seed 20261013; paired differences preserve plant pairing; seeds are not independent plants
evaluation.seed_reporting: per seed and mean-across-seed per plant; representative downstream seed fixed at 17, not best seed

tracking.method: M6-A OfficialTracker unchanged fixed configuration, no training
tracking.sampling_registration: reuse verified label-independent M6-A 256-point 3DEPS XYZ and official CPD cache, same physical point clouds; GT/pred labels never alter geometry sampling
tracking.identities: each frame independently randomized local numbering before tracker; no GT temporal ID; evaluator-only GT identities
tracking.B3: seed17 of better S1/S2 family by average three-seed Validation PQ
tracking.B4: S3 if runnable; explicitly label only one seed and do not call untested Organ3DNet a result
tracking.caveat: biased absolute leaf length/area; improved segmentation/tracking is not whole-system phenotype reliability

strong_baseline.policy: bounded official dependency/example attempt before target adaptation; if actual toolchain/checkpoint blocker, BLOCKED without simplified architecture

continuation.stable_direction: representative seed17 and mean-seed PQ improvements over S0 in >=9/12 Validation plants and paired CI lower >0
decision_order: INSTANCE-SOLVED-FOR-TRACKING if locked segmentation/tracking/event thresholds and stable direction, no pronounced early-small failures
INSTANCE-METHOD-NEEDED only if adequate supervised converged baselines fail with identifiable instance errors and direction evidence stable
DATA-LIMITED if plant-level uncertainty, incomplete strong baseline or bounded convergence evidence prevents stable technical judgment; stop tuning and improve independent data/protocol
